Our Support Services
The International Support Center provides various support services including assistance with ward office procedures and opening a bank account.
To see the available support services, please refer to the image below.
Please note that if you apply after the deadline of three business days prior to the desired support date, we may not be able to provide support at your preferred time.
If you have a specific date and time in mind for support, please apply as early as possible. Even if you apply three business days in advance, due to the reservation acceptance limits of our banking and/or other partners, we may not be able to accommodate your preferred date and time. We appreciate your understanding.

ISC Call Center
About the Call Center
The Call Center provides consultation services related to daily life in Japan.
You can ask about topics such as: ward office bureaucratic procedures, finding medical institutions with English-speaking staff, using the 3-way telephone interpretation service
Matters outside the Call Center’s scope
The Call Center cannot answer questions related to the university, such as course registration, scholarships, student life, admissions, researcher acceptance, employment, or research activities.
For university-related inquiries, please contact the appropriate
contact window listed above
.
Information required when calling
Before making a call, please prepare the following information:
Your name
Your acceptance status (student, researcher, etc.)
Your host department
Your employee/student ID number (if applicable)
Your host professor’s name
Important notes
This is an internet-based call and will be on loudspeaker.
For privacy and better audio quality, we recommend using headphones with a microphone.
Please “allow” use of the microphone. You will not be able to make a call unless you allow it. If you selected “Do not allow” at the start, close the browser and access it again.
Please close other audio apps, such as music and calling apps before making a call.
We recommend using “Do not disturb” mode to avoid receiving incoming calls during a call.
(For iPhone users) Please note that if you switch the screens during interpretation, the connection may be lost.
If you are not connected via Wi-Fi (when using a computer, smartphone, or tablet), data charges may apply.
Language
English, Japanese
*For languages other than English and Japanese, the call center can provide interpretation involving speakers of languages other than English.
Available hours: 8:30–18:00 (Japan time) (including weekends and holidays)
If you have a problem connecting, you can also call the following number.
Tokyo 03-6436-3929 (Call charges apply / Reception hours 8:30-18:00 [every day, including weekends])
